learning_outcomes.text: Acquire the necessary knowledge for the synthesis of mechanisms and machine components.
Establish the basic principles of rigid body dynamics.
Develop the fundamentals of kinematic and dynamic analysis of mechanisms.
Analyze the mechanical characteristics of different machine elements.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION TO THE SYNTHESIS OF MECHANISMS

assessment_methods.method: Laboratory and computer practices (attendance and report)

assessment_rules: The written exam accounts for 80% of the final grade. Laboratory and computer practices account for 5% of the final grade. Student work accounts for 15% of the final grade. In extraordinary calls, students may take a final written exam covering theoretical and practical aspects. Generally, exam questions are graded as 100% for correct or 0% for incorrect, with a 50% option for minor errors. Numerical results in problems must be correct for a 100% score.
